力量有价，选择有回声。: Power has a price. Every choice echoes.
选定武装，改写攻击。带着你的选择走向守门人。: Choose a weapon, rewrite its attack, and carry that choice to the gatekeeper.
重连信标 · 回收遗物 · 护送核心: Relay capture · Relic recovery · Core escort
新行动随机初始武器 · 每次构筑，从意外开始: New runs start with a random weapon · Every build begins with the unexpected
旧世界的魔法，正在新世界重启。: The old world’s magic is rebooting in the new.
她让所有的名字，都长成了树。: She grew every name into a tree.
没有居民的城，仍然需要温暖。: A city without residents still needs warmth.
相位跃迁可以穿过敌人和弹幕。: Phase shift passes through enemies and projectiles.
近身脉冲清除弹幕，引力奇点在准星方向生成引力场。: The close pulse clears projectiles; gravity creates a field toward your reticle.
所有的灯都熄灭了。只有门后，响起了一次迟来的敲门声。: Every light went out. Behind the door, a late knock answered.
每一次重启，都是新的可能。: Every restart opens a new possibility.
下次尝试：保留跃迁躲开红色预警，近身被包围时使用脉冲清弹。: Next run: save your shift for red telegraphs and pulse projectiles when surrounded.
想尝试爆发反应，可组合余烬协议与电弧引擎。此处只统计电浆、热裂变和坍缩，其他共鸣: Try a burst reaction by combining Ember Protocol with Arc Engine. This tracks plasma, thermal fission, and collapse only.
已触发爆发反应（电浆、热裂变或坍缩）；可在协议档案查找更多组合。: Burst reaction triggered (plasma, thermal fission, or collapse). Find more combinations in the Protocol Archive.
按当前键位操作；暂停会冻结计时。存档保持不变。: Use your current bindings; pausing freezes the timer. Your save is unchanged.
建议使用桌面浏览器与键鼠游玩。横向屏幕体验更佳。: Desktop browser and mouse/keyboard recommended. Landscape is best.
以碎片唤醒旧物，部分遗器需要击破对应核心。: Awaken relics with shards. Some relics require a core entity to be defeated.
沿途拾得的只言片语。: Fragments of thought recovered along the route.
记录实体的招式与留下的痕迹。: Record entity attacks and the traces they leave behind.
将带回的碎片刻入行装。这里的武装用于营地推演；正式行动随机起始。准备升级只影响新: Spend recovered shards on your loadout. Camp trials use your chosen weapon; live runs start at random. Preparation upgrades apply to new runs.
选择一套组合，立即感受叠加后的弹道。无敌试炼，不覆盖你的行动存档。: Choose a build and feel its combined projectiles. Trials are invulnerable and never overwrite your run save.
调整声音与战斗反馈。设置保存在当前设备。: Tune audio, combat feedback, and interface language. Settings are saved on this device.
40 项协议，5 种元素。弹体形态、轨迹与命中效果可以自由叠加。: 40 protocols across 5 elements. Combine projectile forms, trajectories, and hit effects.
观察预警，保留一次闪避，在敌人恢复时输出。: Read telegraphs, save a dash, and strike while enemies recover.
形态改写 · 将另外两种武装的特性融入主攻击: Form Rewrite · Blend the other weapons into your primary attack
圣剑的元素作用于剑弧，弹道协议增加次生剑气；重炮的弹道与爆破可叠加。试炼不影响资: Sword elements affect the arc; projectile protocols add secondary blades. Cannon trajectories can combine with blasts. Trials do not affect resources or camp progress.
默认中文，可随时切换 English。: Chinese is the default; switch to English at any time.
关闭震动、角色摆动与残影，减少装饰粒子；保留攻击预警。: Disable camera shake, actor sway, and afterimages; keep attack telegraphs visible.
减少装饰粒子与普通伤害飘字，突出敌弹和玩家位置。: Reduce decorative particles and ordinary damage numbers to emphasize enemy shots and player position.
音乐随区域与战斗变化；重炮和受击声会短暂突出。: Music changes with each area and combat state; cannon fire and damage sounds briefly cut through.
浏览器存储不可用，设置在本次会话内有效。: Browser storage is unavailable; settings last for this session.
以下为默认操作；可在「系统设置 → 操作设置」修改，战斗界面显示当前按键。: Default controls are listed below. Change them in System Settings → Input; the HUD shows your active bindings.
金币：购买补给、重抽协议与碎片归档: Coins: buy supplies, reroll protocols, and bank shards
钥匙：开启封存箱，获得额外协议: Keys: open sealed chests for extra protocols
投放炸弹：0.8 秒后爆破并清弹，不伤自身；也可用于营地破锁: Deploy bomb: detonates in 0.8s, clears projectiles, and can crack camp locks
使用灵药：恢复 40 生命，满血不消耗: Use tonic: restore 40 HP; not consumed at full health
随身碎片：失败仅带回一半，提前归档可保全: Carry shards: only half return on defeat; bank them to keep all
只影响新行动；正在进行的旧行动保持原装备与准备。: Affects new runs only; the current run keeps its loadout and preparation.
带回什么，由你决定。: What you bring back is your choice.
在行商、篝火或核心清场后的中继站可花 8 金币归档全部随身碎片。未归档碎片在失败: At a shop, campfire, or post-core relay, spend 8 coins to bank all carried shards. Half of unbanked shards survive defeat; victory returns all plus 8. Starting a new run abandons unbanked resources from the old run.
已经开启，不能再次领取。: Opened; rewards cannot be claimed again.
每件库存一份。买下现在的安全，或留下纠正流派的钱。: One of each item. Buy safety now or keep coins to correct your build.
